criteria.reason: Favorite/comment handlers import only lib/services + auth + errors; no model import.
Favorites reuses articles.get's N+1-free enrichment; comments.list eager-loads author in ONE query (no per-row loop, unlike the legacy appendFollowers loop it replaces).
{article}/{comments}/{comment}/{message} shapes match the Conduit spec; 200/201/401/403/404/422 preserved.
